reasons.e.spear-tip-attached: 촉에 명암과 두께가 있고 놋쇠 고리로 자루에 끼워져 있다. 납작한 스티커처럼 보이지 않는다.
reasons.e.spear-back-cap: 뒤끝은 앞 촉보다 훨씬 작은 둥근 쇠 덮개다. 양옆으로 벌어진 날이나 미늘은 없다.

prompt: warm cream paper, soft pencil and colored-pencil storybook illustration, gentle hand-drawn lines. A single spear lying flat and horizontal across an empty sheet of plain cream paper, its point at the left end and its back end at the right: a straight wooden shaft two thirds of a man's height, one hand-sized leaf-shaped iron point at the front, a small iron cap at the back, no crossguard. Nothing else on the paper, no person, no hand, no shadow, no text.
